in_arabic.name: عميد
in_arabic.meaning: قائد أو زعيم أو رجل محترم
in_arabic.long_meaning: العميد هو منصب شرفي في الجيش أو الإدارة، ويشير إلى قائد أو زعيم أو رجل محترم، وله أهمية كبيرة في التاريخ الإسلامي والثقافة العربية، حيث كان العديد من القادة والزعماء يحملون هذا اللقب، ويشير إلى الشخصية القوية والمحترمة

in_urdu.name: امید
in_urdu.meaning: قائد یا رہنما یا محترم آدمی
in_urdu.long_meaning: امید کا نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے قائد یا رہنما یا محترم آدمی، اور اس نام کی اہمیت برصغیر پاک و ہند کی مسلم ثقافت میں بہت زیادہ ہے، جہاں کے nhiều قائد اور رہنما اس نام سے مشہور ہوئے ہیں

in_hindi.name: अमीद

in_hindi.long_meaning: अमीद नाम का अर्थ है नेता या मार्गदर्शक या सम्मानित व्यक्ति, और इसका महत्व भारतीय मुसलमान समुदाय में बहुत अधिक है, जहां कई नेता और मार्गदर्शक इस नाम से प्रसिद्ध हुए हैं, और इसका धार्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व भी बहुत अधिक है

data.cultural_impact: The name Amid holds a significant cultural impact as it emphasizes the idea of being present and engaged in one's community. It is a name that reminds us of the importance of being there for each other and being an active participant in life. In Islamic culture, the concept of Amil (the helper, supporter, or assistant) is highly valued, and the name Amid can be seen as a reflection of this ideal.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Amid holds great significance as it is a reminder of the presence of Allah (God) in our lives. It is a name that encourages us to always remember that Allah is with us, in the midst of all our affairs, and to seek His guidance and support at all times. The name Amid can also be seen as a reminder of the mission of every believer to be a "sign of Allah" in the world, to be present and active in spreading His message and spreading kindness and compassion. Overall, the name Amid stands as a powerful reminder of the presence of Allah and the importance of being present and active in both our communities and our personal lives.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Amid was the capital city of the Abbasid Caliphate from 750 to 833 AD. The name Amid carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Amid served as the capital city during the Abbasid Caliphate, an Islamic dynasty that ruled the Islamic world from 750 to 1258 AD. It is located in modern-day Diyarbakır, Turkey.

historical_references.reference: The name Amid came from the Arabic word 'Ammāda' meaning 'fortified' or 'prepared'. The city was strategically located along the trade routes and was fortified to protect against invaders.
historical_references.context: The name 'Amid' is derived from the Arabic word 'Ammāda', which means 'fortified' or 'prepared'. This name reflects the strategic importance of the city as a major trading hub and its defensive fortifications.
